definitions.explanation: A member of the clergy in Protestant Christianity who leads a congregation, conducts worship services, and provides spiritual guidance. Specifically refers to Protestant ministers, not Catholic priests.

examples.japanese: {牧師|ぼくし}が{祈|いの}りを{捧|ささ}げた。
{教会|きょうかい}の{牧師|ぼくし}に{結婚式|けっこんしき}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: We asked the church minister to perform our wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{長年|ながねん}{牧師|ぼくし}として{地域|ちいき}の{人|ひと}たちに{寄|よ}り{添|そ}ってきた。
examples.english: He has been close to the local community as a pastor for many years.

notes:
USAGE:
Specifically refers to Protestant clergy. For Catholic priests, use {神父|しんぷ}. For Buddhist monks or priests, use {僧侶|そうりょ} or {住職|じゅうしょく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牧師|ぼくし}さん (pastor — polite address)
- {牧師|ぼくし}の{説教|せっきょう} (the pastor's sermon)
- {牧師|ぼくし}になる (to become a pastor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {神父|しんぷ}: Catholic priest — used exclusively for Roman Catholic clergy
- {聖職者|せいしょくしゃ}: member of the clergy — general term covering all religious leaders regardless of denomination
